title: Text helper and FITS paths interpret already formatted data again
summary: public wrappers indigo_bus.c:2328,2349 format into tmp then hand tmp to another formatted function; new FITS-header path indigo_ccd_driver.c:862 hands writable header value directly as init_text_item format. Header length<=58 check does not alter format semantics. Public snoop text helpers indigo_agent.c:79-82,97-100 and server service text initialization also use data as format. Use raw setters after initial formatting; tests ordinary percent-bearing data. Active registry dedup found no existing text-reformat record; legacyprintf016 concerns returned length and is distinct. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (CORE-10). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
